# 24. Report emails are sent from the stored copy

Date: 2026-09-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A shop disputed a total in September. The email had been built from the in-memory render while the copy in the report store came from a separate write, so the two could differ and we could not show what the shop had actually been sent.

## Decision

**Words:** 「If a shop disputes a report, the copy we kept has to be the copy they got.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-22

**Options considered:**
- send the in-memory render (rejected: the kept copy can differ from the sent copy)
- send the copy read back from the report store after it is saved (chosen)

**Recommended:** the read-back option.

A report email is built from the copy read back from the report store after it is saved. The mailer never sends the in-memory render.

## Consequences

Each report email costs one extra read of the report store.

input.decision: I moved the shared steps (save, read back, mail, build the result) into one private helper, `saveAndSend`, and each of the three exported functions now makes one call to it. I kept the save-then-read-back step because ADR 0024 requires emails to be sent from the stored copy (Mira's decision, at the cost of one extra read per email). So I didn't remove that read. Exported names, arguments and return values are unchanged. `npm test` has no tests to run, so the change is untested.

recorded.info: Added private helper saveAndSend(shop, kind, key, html, subject), which saves the report, reads it back (ADR 0024), mails it and returns {shopId, kind, bytes}. sendDailyReport, sendWeeklyReport and sendCorrection are now one-line async wrappers that render and call the helper.
